name: Shokushu Chikan Densha ~Joshikousei Midara ni Ochiru~
original_name: 触手痴漢電車　～女子校生淫らに堕ちる～
source:
Main character is a manager in a major electrical equipment company. To release his daily stress he molests girls on the train. One day in the middle of the act he discovers a tentacle growing out of his body. Lucky! There's a whole new world of molesting to experience now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家大型电气设备公司的管理人员。为了释放日常压力，他会在电车上猥亵女孩。某天正要下手时，他发现身体里竟长出一根触手。太幸运了！如今，一个崭新的猥亵世界正在前方等待。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vndb-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
